title: THE BALLAST · OBLIQUE LAPS
vibe: 45 min · green · hard · AMRAP 28:00 · 3 pairs per lap, a flat leg out of every pair, score = laps
why: Heavy slow legs paired with loaded side and stomach work, off two upper days. Every pair ends on a run leg; the sides get hit every lap, not just at the end.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day B — ankles / knees / hips

Single-leg squat to the bench ×5/side · knee drives ×10/side

blocks.title: THE BALLAST · AMRAP 28:00 · 3 PAIRS PER LAP
blocks.meta: AMRAP 28:00 · 4 LAPS target · 6 stations in 3 pairs · 0.12 mi flat leg after every pair · 2×40 lb · 50 lb · 40 lb · 35 lb
blocks.format: One clock. Do the pair, run the leg, straight into the next pair. Score = laps finished at 28:00 (count the pairs of a partial lap).
blocks.workRest: Leg 0.12 mi @ 8.5 flat after every pair. No rest; the leg is the rest. 3 legs per lap.

items.name: P1b · Suitcase deadlift 50 lb ×6/side
items.detail: bell beside the foot, 2-count at the knee, hips level

items.name: P2a · Cossack squat 50 lb ×6/side
items.detail: bell at the chest, heel down

items.name: P2b · Side bend 40 lb ×10/side
items.detail: bell at the hip, 2-count at the bottom, tall on the way up

items.name: P3a · DB snatch 50 lb ×8/side
items.detail: hip snap, punch through at the top

items.name: P3b · Russian twist 35 lb ×20
items.detail: heels off the floor, bell taps the floor each side

blocks.noteGreen: 4 laps is the target, 5 is the stretch. Log laps, the pair that slowed you most, and RPE.
blocks.text: Front squat: 3 seconds down every rep, no bounce. Suitcase deadlift: the free hand stays off the body; do not lean toward the bell.
